gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all available resolutions in Jira to ensure that I can select the appropriate one for my issues.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all resolutions with their IDs and names.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to create a new resolution for our project to better categorize issue completions.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a resolution name and return the created resolution object with its ID.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to set a default resolution for all new issues to streamline our workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a resolution ID and confirm that it has been set as the default.

gold.user: As a project coordinator, I need to reorganize our resolutions to better reflect our current processes.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a list of resolution IDs and their new order, and return the updated list.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to search for specific resolutions by name to quickly find the one I need.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of resolutions that match the search criteria.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to delete obsolete resolutions to keep our project clean and organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the resolution and return a success message.

gold.user: As a QA engineer, I want to retrieve details of a specific resolution to understand its purpose and usage.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified resolution, including its name and description.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to update the details of an existing resolution to reflect changes in our process.
gold.ideal: The API should accept updated resolution details and return the modified resolution object.
